notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
Smothering Abomination's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
